sentences.zh: 後周昌州刺史固七世孫，後徙河南。

translations.literal: He was a seventh-generation descendant of Gu, prefect of Chang Prefecture under Later Zhou; later the family moved to Henan.
translations.idiomatic: He was a seventh-generation descendant of Gu, prefect of Chang Prefecture under Later Zhou. Later the family moved to Henan.

sentences.zh: 長安中，舉學兼流略、詞擅文場科，擢上第，時年十六，以父喪罷。

translations.literal: In the Chang'an era he took the examination for combined learning and broad mastery and for mastery of the literary arena; he placed at the top; he was then sixteen; he withdrew for his father's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chang'an period he took the examination for combined learning and broad mastery and for mastery of the literary arena and placed at the top. He was then sixteen and withdrew for his father's mourning.

sentences.zh: 復舉手筆俊拔科，中之。

translations.literal: He again took the examination for outstanding brushwork and passed.
translations.idiomatic: He again took the examination for outstanding brushwork and passed.

sentences.zh: 補襄邑尉，奏事闕下，會節湣太子難，安樂公主請為皇太女，豫曰：「昔梅福上書譏後族，彼何人哉！」

translations.literal: He was appointed aide at Xiangyi; while presenting matters at court Crown Prince Jiemin fell into crisis; Princess Anle asked to be made imperial crown daughter; Yu said, "In antiquity Mei Fu submitted a memorial mocking the empress's clan — what sort of men were they!"
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed aide at Xiangyi. While presenting matters at court Crown Prince Jiemin fell into crisis and Princess Anle asked to be made imperial crown daughter. Yu said, "In antiquity Mei Fu submitted a memorial mocking the empress's clan — what sort of men were they!"

sentences.zh: 乃上疏請立皇太子，語深切，人為寒懼。

translations.literal: He then submitted a memorial asking that the crown prince be established; the language was deeply earnest; people were chilled with fear.
translations.idiomatic: He then submitted a memorial asking that the crown prince be established. The language was deeply earnest, and people were chilled with fear.

sentences.zh: 太平公主聞其名，將表為諫官，豫恥汙诐謁，遁去。

translations.literal: Princess Taiping heard his name and was about to recommend him as remonstrance official; Yu was ashamed to pay a tainted visit and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Princess Taiping heard his name and was about to recommend him as remonstrance official. Yu was ashamed to pay a tainted visit and fled.

sentences.zh: 俄舉賢良方正異等，為陽翟尉。

translations.literal: Soon he was recommended as outstanding in worth and integrity and became aide at Yangdi.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was recommended as outstanding in worth and integrity and became aide at Yangdi.

sentences.zh: 開元初，觀察使薦豫賢，遷監察御史，出為樂壽令。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kaiyuan the investigating commissioner recommended Yu's worth; he was transferred to investigating censor and sent out as magistrate of Leshou.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Kaiyuan period the investigating commissioner recommended Yu's worth. He was transferred to investigating censor and sent out as magistrate of Leshou.

sentences.zh: 前令以親喪解，而豫母病，訴諸朝，改懷州司倉參軍。

translations.literal: The previous magistrate had left office for parental mourning, but Yu's mother was ill; he appealed to the court and was changed to granary adjutant in Huai Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The previous magistrate had left office for parental mourning, but Yu's mother was ill. He appealed to the court and was changed to granary adjutant in Huai Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 復舉超拔群類科。

translations.literal: He again passed the examination for surpassing all categories.
translations.idiomatic: He again passed the examination for surpassing all categories.

sentences.zh: 會母喪去。

translations.literal: When his mother died he left office.
translations.idiomatic: When his mother died he left office.

sentences.zh: 服除，授大理丞，遷考功員外郎，進絀清明。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was appointed assistant in the Court of Judicial Review, transferred to vice director in the Ministry of Merit Evaluation, and advanced for clarity in evaluation.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended he was appointed assistant in the Court of Judicial Review, transferred to vice director in the Ministry of Merit Evaluation, and advanced for clarity in evaluation.

sentences.zh: 為中書舍人，與韓休、許景先、徐安貞、孫逖名相甲乙。

translations.literal: He became drafting secretary of the Secretariat and with Han Xiu, Xu Jingxian, Xu Anzhen, and Sun Ti was ranked among the foremost.
translations.idiomatic: He became drafting secretary of the Secretariat and with Han Xiu, Xu Jingxian, Xu Anzhen, and Sun Ti was ranked among the foremost.

sentences.zh: 出鄭州刺史。

translations.literal: He was sent out as prefect of Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out as prefect of Zheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 韓休輔政，舉代己，入拜吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: When Han Xiu assisted in governance he recommended Yu to replace himself; Yu entered and was appointed vice minister of personnel.
translations.idiomatic: When Han Xiu assisted in governance he recommended Yu to replace himself. Yu entered court and was appointed vice minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 玄宗曰：「卿前日考功職詳事允，故有今授。」

translations.literal: Xuanzong said, "You previously in the Ministry of Merit Evaluation handled affairs in detail and with fairness — therefore this appointment."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong said, "You previously in the Ministry of Merit Evaluation handled affairs in detail and with fairness — therefore this appointment."

sentences.zh: 豫典選六年，拔寒遠士多至臺閣，當時推知人，號席公雲。

translations.literal: Yu managed selection for six years; many poor and distant scholars he promoted reached the high offices; the age praised his discernment of men and called him Master Xi.
translations.idiomatic: Yu managed selection for six years. Many poor and distant scholars he promoted reached the high offices. Contemporaries praised his discernment of men and called him Master Xi.

sentences.zh: 天寶六載，進禮部尚書，累封襄陽縣子。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Tianbao he was advanced to minister of rites and after repeated enfeoffments became Viscount of Xiangyang county.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Tianbao he was advanced to minister of rites and after repeated enfeoffments became Viscount of Xiangyang County.

sentences.zh: 凡四以使者按行江南、江東、淮南、河北。

translations.literal: In all he four times toured as envoy to inspect Jiangnan, Jiangdong, Huainan, and Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: In all he four times toured as envoy to inspect Jiangnan, Jiangdong, Huainan, and Hebei.

sentences.zh: 南方俗死不葬，暴骨中野，豫教以埋斂，明列科防，俗為之改。

translations.literal: In the south the custom was not to bury the dead but to expose bones in the wild; Yu taught burial and encoffining, clearly set regulations and prohibitions, and the custom was changed.
translations.idiomatic: In the south the custom was not to bury the dead but to expose bones in the wild. Yu taught burial and encoffining, clearly set regulations and prohibitions, and the custom was changed.

sentences.zh: 豫清直亡欲，當官不為勢權所撼。

translations.literal: Yu was pure, upright, and without desire; in office he was not swayed by power and authority.
translations.idiomatic: Yu was pure, upright, and without desire. In office he was not swayed by power and authority.

sentences.zh: 性謹畏，與子弟、屬吏書，不作草字。

translations.literal: By nature he was cautious and reverent; in letters to sons, younger brothers, and subordinate officials he never wrote cursive characters.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was cautious and reverent. In letters to sons, younger brothers, and subordinate officials he never wrote cursive characters.

sentences.zh: 或曰：「此細事耳，何留慮？」

translations.literal: Someone said, "This is a petty matter — why dwell on it?"
translations.idiomatic: Someone said, "This is a petty matter — why dwell on it?"

sentences.zh: 答曰：「細不謹，況大事邪？」

translations.literal: He answered, "If one is not careful in small things, what of great matters?"
translations.idiomatic: He answered, "If one is not careful in small things, what of great matters?"

sentences.zh: 及疾篤，遺令：「三日斂，斂已即葬，勿久留以黷公私；

translations.literal: When his illness was grave he left instructions: "Encoffin within three days; once encoffined bury at once; do not linger long and profane public and private affairs;
translations.idiomatic: When his illness was grave he left instructions: "Encoffin within three days; once encoffined bury at once; do not linger long and profane public and private affairs;

sentences.zh: 貲不足，可賣居宅以終事。」

translations.literal: if funds are insufficient, the residence may be sold to complete the rites."
translations.idiomatic: if funds are insufficient, the residence may be sold to complete the rites."

sentences.zh: 卒，年六十九，贈江陵大都督，謚曰文。

translations.literal: He died at age sixty-nine; posthumously made metropolitan prefect of Jiangling; posthumous title Wen.
translations.idiomatic: He died at sixty-nine. He was posthumously made metropolitan prefect of Jiangling, with the posthumous title Wen.

sentences.zh: 帝嘗登朝元閣賦詩，群臣屬和，帝以豫詩最工，詔曰：「詩人之冠冕也。」

translations.literal: The Emperor once ascended Chaoyuan Pavilion and composed a poem; the hundred ministers matched it; the Emperor considered Yu's poem the most accomplished and decreed, "The crown of poets."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor once ascended Chaoyuan Pavilion and composed a poem. The hundred ministers matched it. The emperor considered Yu's poem the most accomplished and decreed, "The crown of poets."

sentences.zh: 弟晉，亦以文名當時。

translations.literal: His younger brother Jin was also famed for writing in the age.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Jin was also famed for writing in his day.

sentences.zh: =齊澣=齊澣，字洗心，定州義豐人。

translations.literal: Qi Huan. Qi Huan, courtesy name Xixin, was a native of Yifeng in Ding Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Huan. Qi Huan, courtesy name Xixin, came from Yifeng in Ding Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 少開敏，年十四，見特進李嶠，嶠稱有王佐才。

translations.literal: In youth he was quick and keen; at fourteen he met Special Advance Li Jiao; Jiao praised him as having the talent of a chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he was quick and keen. At fourteen he met Special Advance Li Jiao, who praised him as having the talent of a chief minister.

sentences.zh: 中宗在廬陵，澣上言請抑諸武，迎太子東宮，不報。

translations.literal: When Zhongzong was in Luling, Huan submitted a memorial asking to restrain the Wu clan and welcome the crown prince to the eastern palace; there was no reply.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhongzong was in Luling, Huan submitted a memorial asking to restrain the Wu clan and welcome the crown prince to the eastern palace. There was no reply.

sentences.zh: 及太子還，武後召澣宴同明殿，諭曰：「朕母子如初，卿豫有力焉，方不次待爾。」

translations.literal: When the crown prince returned Empress Wu summoned Huan to a banquet in Tongming Hall and instructed him, "My son and I are as at first; you had a forceful part in this; I shall treat you with extraordinary promotion."
translations.idiomatic: When the crown prince returned Empress Wu summoned Huan to a banquet in Tongming Hall and said, "My son and I are as at first. You had a forceful part in this, and I shall treat you with extraordinary promotion."

sentences.zh: 澣辭母老不忍遠離，賞而罷。

translations.literal: Huan declined, saying his mother was old and he could not bear to go far; she rewarded him and dismissed the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Huan declined, saying his mother was old and he could not bear to go far. She rewarded him and dismissed the matter.

sentences.zh: 聖歷初，及進士第，以拔萃調蒲州司法參軍。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shengli he placed in the jinshi examination and through outstanding selection was appointed judicial adjutant in Pu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Shengli period he passed the jinshi examination and through outstanding selection was appointed judicial adjutant in Pu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 有父子連坐論死者，澣曰：「條落則本枯，奈何俱死？」

translations.literal: There was a case where father and son were jointly sentenced to death; Huan said, "When the branches fall the trunk withers — why must both die?"
translations.idiomatic: There was a case where father and son were jointly sentenced to death. Huan said, "When the branches fall the trunk withers — why must both die?"

sentences.zh: 議貸其父，太守不聽，固爭，卒原。

translations.literal: He proposed sparing the father; the prefect would not agree; he argued firmly; in the end the father was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed sparing the father. The prefect would not agree, but he argued firmly until in the end the father was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 景雲初，姚崇取為監察御史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jingyun Yao Chong selected him as investigating censor.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Jingyun period Yao Chong selected him as investigating censor.

sentences.zh: 凡劾奏，常先風教，號善職。

translations.literal: In all impeachments and memorials he always put moral instruction first and was styled excellent in office.
translations.idiomatic: In all impeachments and memorials he always put moral instruction first and was styled excellent in office.

sentences.zh: 睿宗將祠太廟，刑部尚書裴談攝太尉，先告。

translations.literal: When Ruizong was about to sacrifice at the imperial temple, Minister of Justice Pei Tan acted as Grand Marshal and performed the preliminary announcement.
translations.idiomatic: When Ruizong was about to sacrifice at the imperial temple, Minister of Justice Pei Tan acted as Grand Marshal and performed the preliminary announcement.

sentences.zh: 澣奏：「孝享攝事，稽首而拜，恭明神也，而談慢媟不恭。」

translations.literal: Huan memorialized: "In filial sacrifice by proxy one bows with forehead to the ground — this shows reverence to the spirits; yet Tan was negligent, irreverent, and disrespectful."
translations.idiomatic: Huan memorialized: "In filial sacrifice by proxy one bows with forehead to the ground — this shows reverence to the spirits. Yet Tan was negligent, irreverent, and disrespectful."

sentences.zh: 並劾談「神昏形滓，挾邪以罔上。

translations.literal: He also impeached Tan: "His spirit is muddled and his form impure; he harbors evil to deceive his superiors.
translations.idiomatic: He also impeached Tan: "His spirit is muddled and his form impure. He harbors evil to deceive his superiors.

sentences.zh: 神龍時，事武三思，陷敬暉，沒其家以獲進。

translations.literal: In the Shenlong era he served Wu Sansi, framed Jing Hui, and seized his household to advance himself.
translations.idiomatic: During the Shenlong period he served Wu Sansi, framed Jing Hui, and seized his household to advance himself.

sentences.zh: 妻外淫，男女不得姓氏。

translations.literal: His wife committed adultery; the children could not take a surname.
translations.idiomatic: His wife committed adultery, and the children could not take a surname.

sentences.zh: 夫告神慢，事主不忠，家不治，有是三罪，不可不置之法。」

translations.literal: As husband he was negligent toward the spirits; as subject he was disloyal to his lord; as head of household he did not govern the family — with these three crimes he could not but be punished by law."
translations.idiomatic: As husband he was negligent toward the spirits; as subject he was disloyal to his lord; as head of household he did not govern the family. With these three crimes he could not but be punished by law."

sentences.zh: 談由是下除汾州刺史。

translations.literal: Tan was therefore demoted to prefect of Fen.
translations.idiomatic: Tan was therefore demoted to prefect of Fen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 開元初，姚崇復相，用為給事中、中書舍人。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kaiyuan Yao Chong again became chief minister and employed him as attendant within the palace gates and drafting secretary of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Kaiyuan period Yao Chong again became chief minister and employed him as palace attendant and drafting secretary of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 論駁及誥詔皆援準古誼，朝廷大政必咨之，時號「解事舍人」。

translations.literal: In debate and in proclamations and edicts he always cited ancient principle; great affairs of court were always referred to him; the age called him "the drafting secretary who understands affairs."
translations.idiomatic: In debate and in proclamations and edicts he always cited ancient principle. Great affairs of court were always referred to him, and the age called him "the drafting secretary who understands affairs."

sentences.zh: 數諷崇年老宜避位。

translations.literal: He repeatedly hinted that Chong was old and should yield his position.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly hinted that Chong was old and should yield his position.

sentences.zh: 時宋璟在廣州，因勸崇舉自代，崇用其謀。

translations.literal: At the time Song Jing was in Guangzhou; Huan therefore urged Chong to recommend himself as successor, and Chong followed his plan.
translations.idiomatic: Song Jing was then in Guangzhou. Huan urged Chong to recommend himself as successor, and Chong followed his plan.

sentences.zh: 璟為相，它日問曰：「吾不敢冀房、杜，比爾日諸公雲何？」

translations.literal: When Jing became chief minister he one day asked, "I dare not hope to match Fang and Du — compared with the gentlemen of these days, how am I?"
translations.idiomatic: When Jing became chief minister he one day asked, "I dare not hope to match Fang and Du — compared with the gentlemen of these days, how am I?"

sentences.zh: 澣曰：「不如。」

translations.literal: Huan said, "Not as good."
translations.idiomatic: Huan said, "Not as good."

sentences.zh: 璟請故，答曰：「前時近郊戶三百以為困，今不百戶，是以知之。」

translations.literal: Jing asked the reason; he answered, "Formerly three hundred households near the capital were considered distressed; now there are not a hundred — that is how I know."
translations.idiomatic: Jing asked the reason. He answered, "Formerly three hundred households near the capital were considered distressed. Now there are not a hundred — that is how I know."

sentences.zh: 馬懷素等緒次四庫書，表澣為副，改秘書少監。

translations.literal: Ma Huaisu and others compiled the books of the Four Repositories and recommended Huan as deputy; he was changed to vice director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Huaisu and others compiled the books of the Four Repositories and recommended Huan as deputy. He was made vice director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 出為汴州刺史，地當舟車湊集，事浩繁，前刺史數不稱職，唯倪若水與澣以清毅聞，吏民頌美。

translations.literal: He was sent out as prefect of Bian; the place was a gathering point for boats and carts and affairs were vast and complex; several previous prefects had not performed well; only Ni Ruoshui and Huan were known for purity and firmness; officials and people praised them.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out as prefect of Bian, a gathering point for boats and carts where affairs were vast and complex. Several previous prefects had not performed well. Only Ni Ruoshui and Huan were known for purity and firmness, and officials and people praised them.

sentences.zh: 玄宗封太山，歷汴、宋、許，車騎數萬，王公妃主四夷君長馬、橐駝亦數萬，所頓彌數十里。

translations.literal: When Xuanzong performed the feng sacrifice on Mount Tai he passed through Bian, Song, and Xu; chariots and horsemen numbered in the tens of thousands; princes, princesses, consorts, and chieftains of the four barbarians with horses and camels also numbered in the tens of thousands; each halt stretched for miles.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuanzong performed the feng sacrifice on Mount Tai he passed through Bian, Song, and Xu. Chariots and horsemen numbered in the tens of thousands, and princes, princesses, consorts, and chieftains of the four barbarians with horses and camels also numbered in the tens of thousands. Each halt stretched for miles.

sentences.zh: 澣列長棚，帟幕聯亙，上食凡千輿，納筦鑰，身進膳，帝以為知禮，喜甚，為留三日，賜帛二千匹。

translations.literal: Huan set out long pavilions with linked awnings and curtains; meals served amounted to a thousand carts; he received the keys and personally presented the food; the Emperor considered this knowing ritual and was greatly pleased; he stayed three days and bestowed two thousand bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: Huan set out long pavilions with linked awnings and curtains. Meals served amounted to a thousand carts. He received the keys and personally presented the food. The emperor considered this knowing ritual and was greatly pleased. He stayed three days and bestowed two thousand bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 澣以淮至徐城險急，鑿渠十八里，入青水，人便其漕。

translations.literal: Huan, because the route from the Huai to Xucheng was dangerous and steep, cut a canal eighteen li long into the Qing River, and people found transport convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Because the route from the Huai to Xucheng was dangerous and steep, Huan cut a canal eighteen li long into the Qing River, and people found transport convenient.

sentences.zh: 中書令張說擇丞轄，以王丘為左，澣為右。

translations.literal: Chief Minister of the Secretariat Zhang Yue chose assistant commissioners; Wang Qiu was left and Huan was right.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Minister of the Secretariat Zhang Yue chose assistant commissioners. Wang Qiu was left and Huan was right.

sentences.zh: 李元纮、杜暹當國，表宋璟為吏部尚書，澣及蘇晉為侍郎，世謂臺選。

translations.literal: When Li Yuanhong and Du Xian held the state, they recommended Song Jing as minister of personnel and Huan and Su Jin as vice ministers; the age called it the censorate selection.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Yuanhong and Du Xian held the state, they recommended Song Jing as minister of personnel and Huan and Su Jin as vice ministers. The age called it the censorate selection.

sentences.zh: 嘗奏事，帝指政事堂曰：「非卿尚誰居者。」

translations.literal: Once when memorializing the Emperor pointed to the Hall of Administration and said, "If not you, who should sit there?"
translations.idiomatic: Once when memorializing, the emperor pointed to the Hall of Administration and said, "If not you, who should sit there?"

sentences.zh: 是時，開府王毛仲寵甚，與龍武將軍葛福順相婚嫁，毛仲請奏無不從。

translations.literal: At that time Privy Treasurer Wang Maoen was greatly favored; he intermarried with Dragon Martial General Ge Fushun; Maoen's requests and memorials were never refused.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Privy Treasurer Wang Maoen was greatly favored. He intermarried with Dragon Martial General Ge Fushun, and Maoen's requests and memorials were never refused.

sentences.zh: 澣乘間曰：「福順典兵馬，與毛仲為婚家，小人寵極則奸生，不預圖，且有後患。

translations.literal: Huan seized an opportunity and said, "Fushun commands troops and horses and is related by marriage to Maoen; when petty men reach the height of favor wickedness is born — if not planned for in advance there will be later trouble.
translations.idiomatic: Huan seized an opportunity and said, "Fushun commands troops and horses and is related by marriage to Maoen. When petty men reach the height of favor wickedness is born — if not planned for in advance there will be later trouble.

sentences.zh: 高力士小心謹畏，加宦人可備禁中驅使，腹心所委，何必毛仲哉？」

translations.literal: Gao Lishi is careful and reverent; moreover as a eunuch he can serve in the inner palace — he is trusted as a confidant; why need Maoen?"
translations.idiomatic: Gao Lishi is careful and reverent. Moreover as a eunuch he can serve in the inner palace and is trusted as a confidant. Why need Maoen?"

sentences.zh: 又言：「君不密失臣，臣不密失身，惟陛下密此言。」

translations.literal: He also said, "If the ruler is not discreet he loses his ministers; if the minister is not discreet he loses his life — may Your Majesty keep these words secret."
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "If the ruler is not discreet he loses his ministers; if the minister is not discreet he loses his life — may Your Majesty keep these words secret."

sentences.zh: 帝嘉納，且勞曰：「卿第出，我徐計其宜。」

translations.literal: The Emperor commended and accepted it and also consoled him, saying, "You go out first; I shall slowly consider what is fitting."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor commended and accepted it and also consoled him, saying, "You go out first; I shall slowly consider what is fitting."

sentences.zh: 會大理丞麻察坐事，出為興州別駕，澣往餞，因道諫語。

translations.literal: When Assistant in the Court of Judicial Review Ma Cha was implicated in an affair and sent out as assistant administrator of Xing Prefecture, Huan went to see him off and along the way spoke of his remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: When Assistant in the Court of Judicial Review Ma Cha was implicated in an affair and sent out as assistant administrator of Xing Prefecture, Huan went to see him off and along the way spoke of his remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 察素奸佻，遽言狀。

translations.literal: Cha was by nature treacherous and frivolous and immediately reported what had been said.
translations.idiomatic: Cha was by nature treacherous and frivolous and immediately reported what had been said.

sentences.zh: 帝怒，召澣入殿中曰：「卿向疑朕不密，而反告察，謂何？

translations.literal: The Emperor was angry, summoned Huan into the hall and said, "You just now doubted that I was not discreet, yet you in turn told Cha — what does this mean?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was angry, summoned Huan into the hall and said, "You just now doubted that I was not discreet, yet you in turn told Cha — what does this mean?

sentences.zh: 且察輕躁無行，常遊太平門者，詎不知邪？」

translations.literal: Moreover Cha is frivolous and reckless without conduct — one who constantly frequents Taiping Gate — did you not know?"
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Cha is frivolous and reckless without conduct — one who constantly frequents Taiping Gate — did you not know?"

sentences.zh: 澣免冠頓首謝，貶高州良德丞，察再貶皇化尉，其黨齊敷、郭稟皆流放。

translations.literal: Huan removed his cap and bowed with forehead to the ground in apology; he was demoted to assistant magistrate of Liangde in Gao Prefecture; Cha was again demoted to aide at Huanghua; his associates Qi Fu and Guo Bing were all exiled.
translations.idiomatic: Huan removed his cap and bowed with forehead to the ground in apology. He was demoted to assistant magistrate of Liangde in Gao Prefecture. Cha was again demoted to aide at Huanghua, and his associates Qi Fu and Guo Bing were all exiled.

sentences.zh: 久之，澣徙索盧丞、郴州長史、濠常二州刺史。

translations.literal: After a long time Huan was moved to assistant magistrate of Suolu, chief administrator of Chen Prefecture, and prefect of the two prefectures of Hao and Chang.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time Huan was moved to assistant magistrate of Suolu, chief administrator of Chen Prefecture, and prefect of Hao and Chang prefectures.

sentences.zh: 遷潤州，州北距瓜步沙尾，紆匯六十里，舟多敗溺。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Run Prefecture; north of the prefecture at the sand tail of Guabu the route wound and converged for sixty li; many boats were wrecked and sunk.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Run Prefecture. North of the prefecture at the sand tail of Guabu the route wound and converged for sixty li, and many boats were wrecked and sunk.

sentences.zh: 澣徙漕路繇京口埭，治伊婁渠以達揚子，歲無覆舟，減運錢數十萬。

translations.literal: Huan moved the transport route through the Jingkou embankment, repaired the Yilou canal to reach the Yangzi, and in a year there were no capsized boats; transport costs were reduced by several hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Huan moved the transport route through the Jingkou embankment and repaired the Yilou canal to reach the Yangzi. In a year there were no capsized boats, and transport costs were reduced by several hundred thousand.

sentences.zh: 又立伊婁埭，官征其入；

translations.literal: He also established the Yilou embankment and the government collected its revenue;
translations.idiomatic: He also established the Yilou embankment, and the government collected its revenue;

sentences.zh: 招還流人五百戶，置明州以安輯之。

translations.literal: he recalled five hundred households of displaced persons and established Ming Prefecture to settle and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: he recalled five hundred households of displaced persons and established Ming Prefecture to settle and pacify them.

sentences.zh: 復徙汴州。

translations.literal: He was again moved to Bian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was again moved to Bian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 澣中失勢，益悵恨，素操浸衰。

translations.literal: Huan had lost influence at court and grew ever more frustrated and resentful; his former conduct gradually declined.
translations.idiomatic: Huan had lost influence at court and grew ever more frustrated and resentful. His former conduct gradually declined.

sentences.zh: 更倚力士助，得為兩道采訪使，興利以中天子意，裒貨財遺謝貴幸。

translations.literal: He relied more on Lishi's help, became investigating commissioner of two circuits, created profit to match the Son of Heaven's wishes, and gathered wealth to gift and thank the favored and powerful.
translations.idiomatic: He relied more on Lishi's help, became investigating commissioner of two circuits, created profit to match the emperor's wishes, and gathered wealth to gift and thank the favored and powerful.

sentences.zh: 納劉戒女為妾，不答其妻。

translations.literal: He took Liu Jie's daughter as a concubine and did not answer his wife.
translations.idiomatic: He took Liu Jie's daughter as a concubine and did not answer his wife.

sentences.zh: 李林甫惡其行，欲擠而廢之。

translations.literal: Li Linfu hated his conduct and wished to squeeze him out and dismiss him.
translations.idiomatic: Li Linfu hated his conduct and wished to squeeze him out and dismiss him.

sentences.zh: 會其幕府坐贓，事連澣，詔矜澣老，放歸田裏。

translations.literal: When his staff were implicated in corruption and the affair touched Huan, an edict took pity on Huan's age and released him to return to his fields.
translations.idiomatic: When his staff were implicated in corruption and the affair touched Huan, an edict took pity on Huan's age and released him to return to his fields.

sentences.zh: 天寶初，召為太子少詹事，留司東都。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianbao he was summoned as junior steward of the crown prince's household and remained on duty in the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Tianbao period he was summoned as junior steward of the crown prince's household and remained on duty in the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 嚴挺之亦為林甫所廢，與澣家居，杖屨經過不缺日，林甫畏之，乃用澣為平陽太守，離其謀。

translations.literal: Yan Tingzhi had also been dismissed by Linfu; he and Huan lived at home; with staff and sandals they visited each other without missing a day; Linfu feared them and therefore appointed Huan prefect of Pingyang to separate their plotting.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Tingzhi had also been dismissed by Linfu. He and Huan lived at home and with staff and sandals visited each other without missing a day. Linfu feared them and therefore appointed Huan prefect of Pingyang to separate their plotting.

sentences.zh: 更以黃老清靜為治，卒，年七十二。

translations.literal: He further governed by the quiet purity of Huang-Lao teaching and died at age seventy-two.
translations.idiomatic: He further governed by the quiet purity of Huang-Lao teaching and died at seventy-two.

sentences.zh: 肅宗時，錄林甫所陷者，皆褒洗，故澣贈禮部尚書。

translations.literal: In the time of Suzong those whom Linfu had ruined were recorded and all were praised and rehabilitated; therefore Huan was posthumously made minister of rites.
translations.idiomatic: During the reign of Emperor Suzong those whom Linfu had ruined were recorded and all were praised and rehabilitated. Huan was therefore posthumously made minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 澣嘗稱陳希烈、宋遙、苗晉卿、韋述之才，後皆大顯。

translations.literal: Huan once praised the talent of Chen Xilie, Song Yao, Miao Jinqing, and Wei Shu; all later achieved great prominence.
translations.idiomatic: Huan once praised the talent of Chen Xilie, Song Yao, Miao Jinqing, and Wei Shu. All later achieved great prominence.

sentences.zh: 麻察者，河東人，由明經第五遷殿中侍御史。

translations.literal: Ma Cha was a man of Hedong; through placing fifth in the Mingjing examination he was promoted to attending censor within the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Cha was a man of Hedong. Through placing fifth in the Mingjing examination he was promoted to attending censor within the palace.

sentences.zh: 魏元忠子升死節湣太子難，而元忠系大理，升妻鄭父遠，嘗納錢五百萬，以女易官。

translations.literal: Wei Yuanzhong's son Sheng died in Crown Prince Jiemin's crisis; Yuanzhong was imprisoned in the Court of Judicial Review; Sheng's wife was Zheng; her father Yuan had once paid five million cash to exchange his daughter for office.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Yuanzhong's son Sheng died in Crown Prince Jiemin's crisis while Yuanzhong was imprisoned in the Court of Judicial Review. Sheng's wife was a Zheng; her father Yuan had once paid five million cash to exchange his daughter for office.

sentences.zh: 武後重元忠舊臣，欲榮其姻對，授遠河內令，子洛州參軍。

translations.literal: Empress Wu valued Yuanzhong as an old minister and wished to honor his marriage connection; she appointed Yuan magistrate of Henei and his son military adjutant in Luo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Wu valued Yuanzhong as an old minister and wished to honor his marriage connection. She appointed Yuan magistrate of Henei and his son military adjutant in Luo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元忠下獄，遣人絕婚，許之。

translations.literal: When Yuanzhong was imprisoned he sent someone to break off the marriage; Yuan agreed.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuanzhong was imprisoned he sent someone to break off the marriage, and Yuan agreed.

sentences.zh: 明日，嫁其女。

translations.literal: The next day he married off his daughter.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he married off his daughter.

sentences.zh: 察劾遠敗風教，請錮終身，遠遂廢。

translations.literal: Cha impeached Yuan for corrupting moral instruction and asked that he be barred for life; Yuan was therefore ruined.
translations.idiomatic: Cha impeached Yuan for corrupting moral instruction and asked that he be barred for life. Yuan was therefore ruined.

sentences.zh: 當時謂察為公，而終以憸險斥雲。

translations.literal: At the time people called Cha fair, yet in the end he was dismissed for treacherous and dangerous conduct.
translations.idiomatic: At the time people called Cha fair, yet in the end he was dismissed for treacherous and dangerous conduct.

sentences.zh: 澣孫抗。

translations.literal: Huan's grandson Kang.
translations.idiomatic: Huan's grandson Kang.

sentences.zh: 抗字遐舉，少值天寶亂，奉母夫人隱會稽。

translations.literal: Kang, courtesy name Xiaju, in youth encountered the Tianbao turmoil and supported his mother in seclusion in Kuaiji.
translations.idiomatic: Kang, courtesy name Xiaju, in youth encountered the Tianbao turmoil and supported his mother in seclusion in Kuaiji.

sentences.zh: 壽州刺史張鎰辟署幕府。

translations.literal: Shou Prefecture prefect Zhang Yi recruited him to his staff.
translations.idiomatic: Shou Prefecture prefect Zhang Yi recruited him to his staff.

sentences.zh: 抗吏事閑敏，有文雅，從鎰鎮江西。

translations.literal: Kang was quick and adept in office affairs and had literary refinement; he followed Yi to garrison Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Kang was quick and adept in office affairs and had literary refinement. He followed Yi to garrison Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 及以宰相領鳳翔，奏署監察御史。

translations.literal: When Yi as chief minister also held Fengxiang he memorialized to appoint Kang investigating censor.
translations.idiomatic: When Yi as chief minister also held Fengxiang he memorialized to appoint Kang investigating censor.

sentences.zh: 李楚琳亂，奔奉天，授侍御史，遷戶部員外郎。

translations.literal: When Li Chulin rebelled he fled to Fengtian, was appointed attending censor, and was transferred to vice director in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Chulin rebelled he fled to Fengtian, was appointed attending censor, and was transferred to vice director in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 蕭復引為江淮宣慰判官。

translations.literal: Xiao Fu brought him in as judge on the Jiang-Huai pacification commission.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Fu brought him in as judge on the Jiang-Huai pacification commission.

sentences.zh: 德宗自梁、洋還，財用大屈，鹽鐵使元琇薦抗材，改倉部郎中，斡鹽利。

translations.literal: When Dezong returned from Liang and Yang finances were greatly strained, Salt and Iron Commissioner Yuan Xiu recommended Kang's talent; he was changed to director in the Granary Section and managed salt profits.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Dezong returned from Liang and Yang finances were greatly strained, Salt and Iron Commissioner Yuan Xiu recommended Kang's talent. He was made director in the Granary Section and managed salt profits.

sentences.zh: 俄為水陸運副使，護漕江淮，給京師。

translations.literal: Soon he became deputy commissioner for water and land transport, supervised grain transport on the Jiang and Huai, and supplied the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he became deputy commissioner for water and land transport, supervised grain transport on the Jiang and Huai, and supplied the capital.

sentences.zh: 歷諫議大夫，坐小累，為處州刺史。

translations.literal: He served as grand remonstrator; for a minor offense he became prefect of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: He served as grand remonstrator. For a minor offense he became prefect of Chu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 歷蘇州，徙潭州觀察使，召為給事中，遷河南尹，進太常卿，以中書侍郎同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: He served in Su Prefecture, was moved to investigating commissioner of Tan Prefecture, was summoned as attendant within the palace gates, transferred to intendant of Henan, advanced to chief of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and as vice minister of the Secretariat became co-equal with the chief ministers of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: He served in Su Prefecture, was moved to investigating commissioner of Tan Prefecture, was summoned as palace attendant, transferred to intendant of Henan, advanced to chief of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and as vice minister of the Secretariat became co-equal with the chief ministers of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 抗無遠謀大略，雖用心至精，末乃滋彰苛刻。

translations.literal: Kang had no far-reaching strategy or broad design; though he applied himself with utmost precision, in the end his harshness became ever more evident.
translations.idiomatic: Kang had no far-reaching strategy or broad design. Though he applied himself with utmost precision, in the end his harshness became ever more evident.

sentences.zh: 以病乞身，罷為太子賓客。

translations.literal: On grounds of illness he requested to leave office and was dismissed to become companion of the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On grounds of illness he requested to leave office and was dismissed to become companion of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 卒，年六十五，贈戶部尚書，謚曰成。

translations.literal: He died at age sixty-five; posthumously made minister of revenue; posthumous title Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: He died at sixty-five. He was posthumously made minister of revenue, with the posthumous title Cheng.

sentences.zh: 初，吏部歲考書言，以它官第上下，中書、門下遣官覆實，以為常。

translations.literal: Earlier the Ministry of Personnel each year in the merit evaluation memorial ranked officials higher or lower; the Secretariat and Chancellery sent officials to verify the facts — this was customary.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Ministry of Personnel each year in the merit evaluation memorial ranked officials higher or lower. The Secretariat and Chancellery sent officials to verify the facts — this was customary.

sentences.zh: 抗以尚書、侍郎皆大臣選，今更覆核，非任人勿疑之道。

translations.literal: Kang held that ministers and vice ministers were all chosen as great ministers; to verify them again was not the way of employing men without doubting them.
translations.idiomatic: Kang held that ministers and vice ministers were all chosen as great ministers. To verify them again was not the way of employing men without doubting them.

sentences.zh: 禮部侍郎試貢士，其姻舊悉試考功，謂之「別頭」，皆奏罷之。

translations.literal: When the vice minister of rites tested tribute scholars, all his affines and old associates were tested by the Ministry of Merit Evaluation — called "separate head" — and he memorialized to abolish all of this.
translations.idiomatic: When the vice minister of rites tested tribute scholars, all his affines and old associates were tested by the Ministry of Merit Evaluation — called "separate head" — and he memorialized to abolish all of this.

sentences.zh: 又省州別駕、田曹司田官、判司雙曹者，減中書吏員。

translations.literal: He also eliminated assistant administrators of prefectures, field-section officials, and dual assistant positions, and reduced the clerical staff of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He also eliminated assistant administrators of prefectures, field-section officials, and dual assistant positions, and reduced the clerical staff of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 此其稍近治者雲。

translations.literal: These were among his measures that came somewhat close to good governance.
translations.idiomatic: These were among his measures that came somewhat close to good governance.
